title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → AwardHonor
architecture_notes: Workday Student records academic honors (Latin honors, dean's list) against the student's academic record and program of study completion, and awards through the student's honors and awards data. Equivalent PeopleSoft records: PS_ACAD_DEGR_HONS, PS_HONOR_AWARD_CS.

source_objects.description: Honor assigned to a student for a period or on completion: dean's list, Latin honors.

source_objects.object: Program of Study Completion / Academic Credential

source_objects.description: Institutional, departmental, and external awards. VALIDATE: some tenants use Student Recruiting or custom objects.

notes: Honors are directory information at many schools, but only if the school's annual FERPA notice lists them. Check FERPARestriction before publishing any honor (commencement programs, press releases, dean's list feeds).
validate: Workday object and field names vary by release and tenant. VALIDATE against your tenant's report data sources before building extracts.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from the honor or award Reference_ID.

attribute_mappings.source: Academic Honor Type / Student Award Type
attribute_mappings.transformation: Map tenant types to the HELIX values.
Map local honors codes to cum_laude, magna_cum_laude, summa_cum_laude; 'none' for non-Latin honors. Keep the code-to-designation lookup in one seed table.
GPA the honor was based on, when the honor is GPA-driven.
Only for awards with a cash value. Scholarships already live in FinAidAward; set scholarship_flag and don't double-count the dollars in reporting.
honor_type = national_award (Fulbright, Goldwater, Truman, and similar).
